transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's go ahead and get started. As we all know, we're reviewing the vendor's draft agreement for the AI platform that will handle our customer-support chats and call transcripts starting next quarter. The vendor has provided their standard data-use, liability, insurance, and audit provisions, and I'll be giving final approval before we sign. I'd like to hear from each of you in turn -- privacy, insurance, and customer-contracts counsel -- on your findings. Who would like to start?

transcript.text: I'd like to start with my privacy findings. During my review of the proposed data flows against our company's privacy inventory, I confirmed that the platform will process identifiable customer call transcripts. Because of that, our approved data-processing standard applies and requires several specific terms that have not yet been entered into the contract redline: deletion of all data within exactly 7 calendar days after termination, a prohibition on using customer content for model training, a prohibition on use for service improvement, and processing exclusively within the European Union. These are mandatory requirements under our standard and need to be reflected in the agreement before we can move forward.
